title: ever LEORA|A-Line Pleated Chiffon Tie-Waist Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This A-line chiffon dress offers a flattering pleated design that enhances your natural shape. The tie-waist detail adds a touch of elegance, while the lightweight fabric ensures comfort and movement. Perfect for wedding guests, this versatile dress combines style and grace for any formal occasion.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Floor-Length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: No zipper.

Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: No stretch.

Occasion: Bridesmaid dress, evening dress, banquet, formal birthday dress
